info.title: hubspot (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated hubspot API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts from the HubSpot CRM.
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts from the HubSpot CRM.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page (default 10, max 100).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for fetching the next page of results.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of contact properties to include.

post.summary: Add a new contact record to HubSpot CRM.
post.description: Add a new contact record to HubSpot CRM.

requestBody.description: {properties: {email, firstname, lastname, phone, company, jobtitle, lifecyclestage}}

get.summary: Fetch complete details for one contact record by its HubSpot ID.
get.description: Fetch complete details for one contact record by its HubSpot ID.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: HubSpot ID of the contact to retrieve.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include.

patch.summary: Modify properties on an existing HubSpot contact.
patch.description: Modify properties on an existing HubSpot contact.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: HubSpot ID of the contact to update.

requestBody.description: {properties: {email, firstname, lastname, phone, company, jobtitle, lifecyclestage, linkedin_url}}

post.summary: Filter and query contacts using property-based criteria. Find or look up contacts by any property value.
post.description: Filter and query contacts using property-based criteria. Find or look up contacts by any property value.

requestBody.description: {filterGroups: [{filters: [{propertyName: string, operator: string (EQ|NEQ|LT|LTE|GT|GTE|BETWEEN|IN|NOT_IN|CONTAINS_TOKEN|NOT_CONTAINS_TOKEN|HAS_PROPERTY|NOT_HAS_PROPERTY), value: string, highValue?: string, values?: [string]}]}], sorts: [{propertyName: string, direction: string}], limit: int, after: string}

put.summary: Link a contact to a deal. The associationType is a numeric ID (e.g., 3 for deal_to_contact).
put.description: Link a contact to a deal. The associationType is a numeric ID (e.g., 3 for deal_to_contact).

parameters.name: dealId
parameters.description: HubSpot ID of the deal.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: HubSpot ID of the contact to link.

parameters.name: associationType
parameters.description: Numeric identifier for the association type (e.g., 3 for deal_to_contact, 5 for deal_to_company).

post.summary: Record a note activity in HubSpot. Log free-form text attached to contacts, companies, or deals.
post.description: Record a note activity in HubSpot. Log free-form text attached to contacts, companies, or deals.

requestBody.description: {properties: {hs_note_body (required), hs_timestamp}, associations: [{to: {id: string}, types: [{associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId: int}]}]}

post.description: Record an email activity in HubSpot. Log an email message linked to contacts, companies, or deals.

requestBody.description: {properties: {hs_email_text or hs_email_html (required), hs_email_subject, hs_email_direction, hs_timestamp}, associations: [{to: {id: string}, types: [{associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId: int}]}]}

post.summary: Record a call activity in HubSpot. Log a phone conversation linked to contacts, companies, or deals.
post.description: Record a call activity in HubSpot. Log a phone conversation linked to contacts, companies, or deals.

requestBody.description: {properties: {hs_call_body (required), hs_call_title, hs_call_duration, hs_call_direction, hs_timestamp}, associations: [{to: {id: string}, types: [{associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId: int}]}]}

post.summary: Record a meeting activity in HubSpot. Log a scheduled meeting linked to contacts, companies, or deals.
post.description: Record a meeting activity in HubSpot. Log a scheduled meeting linked to contacts, companies, or deals.

requestBody.description: {properties: {hs_meeting_body (required), hs_meeting_title, hs_meeting_start_time, hs_meeting_end_time, hs_timestamp}, associations: [{to: {id: string}, types: [{associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId: int}]}]}

post.summary: Create an engagement (activity) in HubSpot. This is a legacy unified endpoint for logging notes, emails, calls, meetings
post.description: Create an engagement (activity) in HubSpot. This is a legacy unified endpoint for logging notes, emails, calls, meetings, or tasks. Prefer the dedicated per-type endpoints (/notes, /emails, /calls, /meetings, /tasks).

200.description: Created Engagement with id and type

requestBody.description: {properties: {engagement_type (required: NOTE|EMAIL|CALL|MEETING|TASK), body}, associations: [{to: {id: string}, types: [{associationCategory: "HUBSPOT_DEFINED", associationTypeId: int}]}]}

id.description: HubSpot-assigned unique identifier for this contact.

hs_note_body.description: Body of the note in HTML or plain text.

hs_call_body.description: Notes recorded during or after the call.
